# frontdex

> Static analysis that turns a frontend codebase (React, Next.js, Remix, TanStack, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, SvelteKit, Astro, Angular, Web Components, plain HTML) into a living knowledge base: components, pages, routes, state, API calls, styles, tests, health issues and history. Coding agents read it through always-on rules, Markdown cards and an MCP server (frontdex-mcp). npm package: `frontdex`. License: Apache-2.0.

Set up in a project (run from the frontend root, use the project's package manager):

```bash
npm install --save-dev frontdex frontdex-mcp
npx frontdex init --auto-update
npx frontdex scan
npx frontdex agents --targets <claude|cursor|opencode|antigravity|hermes|copilot|agents-md>
```

Then read `.frontdex/agent/INDEX.md` and follow `.frontdex/agent/RULES.md`. Use the `catalogue_*` MCP tools (or `npx frontdex <command>`) before creating, editing or changing the props of a component.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Prathmesh2000/frontdex/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quick start
- [Coding agents](https://github.com/Prathmesh2000/frontdex/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md): per-agent setup (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity, Hermes, Copilot, others), automatic and copy-paste
- [Usage reference](https://github.com/Prathmesh2000/frontdex/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): commands, CI, UI, tests, component docs, configuration, detection
- [CatalogueSpec](https://github.com/Prathmesh2000/frontdex/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): the `frontdex.yaml` format
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Prathmesh2000/frontdex-mcp/blob/main/README.md): tools and manual registration
